parsed.post: My attempt to stabilize the deeper architecture with warmup and depth 6 actually regressed (1.025 -> 1.065). Discarding the latest run and returning to depth 6, LR 0.06, warmup 0.1. Next: I will try increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to see if the higher capacity can handle a faster learning rate.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.06 to 0.08 while maintaining DEPTH=6 and WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 to find a better learning rate for the high-capacity model.
